body:
Follow-up from the #292 mixed-era placement audit (item 3 of 5). Implements the agreed strictness stance: **liberal read, strict maintenance**.

## Decision (from #292)

A committed `placement` vector is valid **iff** it is empty (pre-M3 → identity fallback) or `len == fragment_count()` (explicit). A non-empty vector of any other length is **malformed** — no current writer produces one (the write path always emits a full-length vector; only `#[serde(default)]` yields empty), so today this can only mean truncation/corruption.

## Change

- **Read path** stays liberal: keep the per-index `placed_dserver` fallback so a still-readable record is never made unreadable over a length quirk (availability).
- **Maintenance loops** stop silently fabricating identity entries for the missing tail of a malformed vector:
  - GC (`gc.rs:referenced_fragments`) / scrub: treat a chunk with a malformed placement as **fully referenced** (never reclaim any of its fragments) and emit an audit event / counter on the durability-plane seam (ADR-0011).
  - Reconstruction (`reconstruction.rs:assess`) / rebalance (`rebalance.rs:plan_evacuations`): **skip** the chunk and flag NEEDS-HUMAN rather than act on fabricated placement.

Suggest a small classifier on `ChunkRef` (e.g. `placement_state() -> Empty | Full | Malformed`) so the three legitimate behaviors are decided in one place and reused by the maintenance loops.

## Test

For each maintenance loop, a chunk with a non-empty wrong-length placement: GC/scrub do not delete and emit the audit signal; reconstruction/rebalance skip + flag. Confirm the read path still resolves such a chunk via per-index fallback (unchanged).

## Depends on

Best landed after the `ChunkRef::fragments()` helper issue, so the classifier and the maintenance loops share one expansion path.

milestone.title: M3 — Custodians
milestone.description: The self-maintaining durability plane (L4): GC, scrub, reconstruction, rebalance + durability telemetry. Makes single-zone trustworthy; gates the Step-2 release. Plan: proposal 0005.

title: Maintenance loops should reject malformed placement lengths instead of silent identity fallback
